title: Definitely recommend!
text: We had a great time! Ida was a great guide. She was very knowledgeable and a lot of fun. The food was also delicious - it was a great mix of meats and seafood.
author: Joseph_C

title: Food and Fun!
text: Great way to experience the food and culture in vibrant Barcelona. We immersed ourselves in the atmosphere of food and fellowship all while experiencing the history and beauty of this great city. Ida was our guide and we can’t recommend her enough! She is knowledgeable and experienced in all things Tapas but most of all she is FUN! She made our experience and helped us fall in love with all things Barcelona! Highly recommend this tour and Ida!
author: Jessica_L

title: Amazing food!
text: Ida was really nice as she texted in advance to let me know that I was the only one. As it was so cold and I had a late lunch, I couldn’t finish a lot of the food! I asked for the smallest portion and tried what she recommended. The tapas were very good! Love the gammon ham, croquette and fried octopus! The sangria was oooohhhh!!!!!! Really do need to go with an empty stomach!
author: Joanne_L

title: Local food and drinks
text: An authentic walk through the Gothic and Born areas with stops at small local restaurants. Simple tapas and drinks. Very nice!
author: Coke_S

title: Great tour highly recommend in Barcelona
text:
I was the only person since it was off season but Ida was kind enough to still offer the tour. She had great recommendations and knew a lot about the city, culture and history. She chose two places that both had great ambiance and didn’t feel like tourist traps and were off the beaten path. She ordered a good variety of food and options to choose from. All the food was delicious and I got to try more than three dishes at each place and good varieties. 
Ida was lovely and easy to talk to, and dropped me back off at my hotel. I would highly recommend this tour and Ida.
author: Lindsaypmac

title: First time doing a food tour
text: This was the first time we had done a food tour so did not know what to expect. My wife and I had amazing night, good food and drink and paired with a friendly couple from the USA. Ida was amazing knowledgeable of the food and the city. Thanks for an excellent evening.
author: Trip31149858756

title: Great Introduction After Long Travel
text: We had a fantastic time! Ida was great, so personable. We enjoyed tons of food and a leisurely walk around the neighborhood. I would highly recommend.
author: Michael_R

title: Went above and beyond, very informative and the food was great.
text: We ended up missing our Lunch Tapas Tour due to a flight delay but they kindly switched us to a dinner Tapas Tour just for us. Very professional and much appreciated.
author: Christy J
